description.value: Angry Otter Liquor is a retail liquor store operated under the Otter Co-op brand, a locally-owned co-operative serving communities across the Fraser Valley and beyond. Located in a commercial strip on Sumas Way in Chilliwack, it offers beer, wine, and spirits for purchase. Touring cyclists passing through the area might stop here for resupply, though it is a standard chain retail outlet rather than a cycling-oriented destination.

address.value: 1201 Sumas Way, Unit 101, Chilliwack, BC V2S 8H2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is largely CMS template boilerplate with almost no rendered data — the contact page stub shows 'HOURS, LOCATIONS & CONTACT INFO' but no actual details loaded. OSM tags confirm this is an Otter Co-op alcohol retail shop at 1201 Sumas Way, Unit 101, Chilliwack. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all amenity fields default to null.
concerns: Website content rendered as CMS boilerplate with no actual location/contact data visible — phone number and address could not be verified against the website.
OSM website URL uses an unusual TLD (.crs) which may be a co-op registry domain; the site did resolve but content was minimal.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a standard chain retail liquor store with no confirmed cycling amenities and no meaningful cyclist-oriented offering beyond incidental resupply; it does not meet the threshold for a WWC cycling tourism directory listing.
